newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bills falls to 5.72 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bills falls to 5.72 percent.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills fell to 5.72 percent from 5.74 last week, a spokeswoman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price climbed to 98.575 from 98.570 last week while the minimum price accepted was 98.553.
Banks submitted bids for 22 million dinars worth of bills, down from 31.4 million dinars the previous week. The bills, maturing on October 8, were offered on Monday and would be issued on Wednesday.
